event_data.context:
Why it matters: the current interpretation can create an infinite review loop even though no reviewed source changed.

Implementation notes
Update the final-review skill and protocol plus delivery guidance. Keep the active-review scope hash stage-aware. Restart review only for changes to reviewed paths, contents, modes, untracked content, pinned baseline, or requested scope. Keep exact-commit post-commit gates mandatory, with commit-message and signature checks classified as delivery verification.
event_data.summary: Final review should approve the final source-content snapshot once, then cross a one-way delivery boundary through commit and push. A content-identical commit must not trigger another full source review merely because Git staging partitions, HEAD, signing, or commit metadata changed.
event_data.title: Prevent redundant final review after content-identical delivery
